dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, why do people go to the temple?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwaɪ duː ˈpiːpəl ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈtɛmpəl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They go there to make merit.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈɡoʊ ˈðɛr tə ˌmeɪk ˈmɛrɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Make merit? What does that mean?
dialogue.reading: ˌmeɪk ˈmɛrɪt? ˈwʌt dʌz ðæt ˈmiːn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It means doing good things. People give food to the monks in the morning.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈmiːnz ˈduːɪŋ ˈɡʊd ˈθɪŋz. ˈpiːpəl ˈɡɪv ˈfuːd tə ðə ˈmʌŋks ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And what are these candles for?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt ər ðiːz ˈkændəlz ˈfɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: People buy them to give to the monks. It's a tradition in July.
dialogue.reading: ˈpiːpəl ˈbaɪ ðɛm tə ˈɡɪv tə ðə ˈmʌŋks. ɪts ə trəˈdɪʃən ɪn dʒuˈlaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Do people go to the temple for luck, too?
dialogue.reading: duː ˈpiːpəl ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈtɛmpəl fər ˈlʌk, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I go there before every exam. I need a lot of luck!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪ ˈɡoʊ ˈðɛr bɪˈfɔːr ˈɛvri ɪɡˈzæm. aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈlʌk!
